home.title: Architecture and interiors in Kozhikode, Kerala
home.hero_title: Villas with a sense of arrival.
home.hero_description: Contemporary, traditional and colonial homes, planned and detailed by one studio in Kozhikode.
home.material_description: Marble floors and a waved ceiling at Rashid Villa. Teak and exposed timber at Iqbal Villa. Laterite and carved wood at Dr. Vikrant Residence.
home.craft_detail_description: At Girish Villa, a curved stairway sits on axis with the entrance. Crisp white walls and soft lighting carry through every floor.
home.craft_space_description: At Rashid Villa, a waved ceiling and plenty of seating make the living room the hub of the house.

home.service_two_body: Ceilings, floors, joinery and lighting detailed together with the building.
home.service_three_body: Gardens, courtyards and entrance approaches designed with the house.
home.service_four_body: Site plans for larger developments, resorts and cultural projects.

work.title: Projects
work.page_lead: Villas and residences in Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra and beyond.

studio.title: About
studio.page_lead: Architects, designers and consultants working together from Kozhikode.
studio.statement_body: From Kerala tharavads to colonial bungalows, each house follows what the family asks for and what the site allows.
studio.proportion_body: Neethu Karnadas (technical director) and Gabish Kareem (director) complete the leadership team.
studio.closing_body: One team carries a house from the first sketch to the finished rooms.

process.title: Approach
process.page_lead: Design is a conversation between the architect and the client.
process.step_one_body: Learn how the house will be lived in, what the client wants and what the plot allows.
process.step_two_body: Architecture, interiors and landscape are planned together, so rooms, ceilings and gardens read as one.
process.step_three_title: Detail it, then see it built.
process.step_three_body: Finishes, joinery and lighting are drawn up with the building, and the studio stays with the project to the end.
process.closing_body: Homes that suit their climate and their families for years.

projects.name: Rashid Villa
projects.tagline: A calm villa of marble, warm wood and soft light.
projects.detail_caption: The living room, under a waved ceiling.
projects.alt: Evening view of the villa lit across a lawn, with white columns and a long veranda
projects.intro: Rashid Villa is a contemporary home that balances the owner's lifestyle with modern architecture. A pool room, a large kitchen and wide marble corridors sit alongside the main rooms.
projects.story: The architects built the house around a soothing, uncluttered quality. Marble floors and contemporary lighting keep every room fresh and inviting.
projects.detail_title: The living room sets the tone.
projects.detail: An eye-catching waved ceiling and plenty of seating make the living room the hub of the house. Bedrooms use 3D wall boards and glossy marble outlines for a calm finish.

projects.name: Girish Villa
projects.tagline: An artistic white home built around a curved stair.
projects.detail_caption: The curved stair, seen from the lounge.
projects.alt: White columns and a curved staircase in the entrance hall of Girish Villa
projects.intro: Girish Villa is an 8,000 sq ft home designed to give an artistic, whole-house experience. Crisp white walls, bright lighting and bits of colour run through it.
projects.story: A curved stairway faces the entrance and gives a clear view of the dining hall as you descend. The kitchen sits to the left, with the dining hall in the centre.
projects.detail: The ground floor holds the sitting room, dining room, pooja room and bedrooms. A home theatre and balconies sit on the first floor.

projects.name: Iqbal Villa
projects.tagline: Traditional Kerala architecture with a contemporary finish.
projects.alt: Night view of the villa entrance with tall white pillars and warm lighting
projects.intro: Iqbal Villa fuses traditional Kerala architecture with a contemporary style, as the client wanted. A large car porch under an exposed timber ceiling leads into the house.
projects.story: Teak-panelled pillars carry the porch ceiling. Inside, a patterned multi-wood ceiling is the highlight of the living room.
projects.detail: Floor beds combine Italian marble and teak. Side walls use 3D board and veneer finishes. The U-shaped kitchen pairs white counters with black cabinets.

projects.name: Dr. Vikrant Residence
projects.tagline: Wada walls and coastal laterite in one home.
projects.alt: Exterior of a sloped-roof house with tiled roof and laterite wall
projects.intro: Dr. Vikrant Patkar's home in Mumbai blends North and South Indian influences. It joins the thermal comfort of Deccan wadas with monsoon-ready coastal features.
projects.story: Thick stone walls regulate temperature and last. Locally sourced laterite adds weather resistance. Carved wooden elements and wide verandas link old craft to modern comfort.
projects.detail: Dark teak furniture, patterned cushions and tall curtains set a warm, grounded mood in the main sitting room.

projects.name: Sunil Kumar Gowda Residence
projects.tagline: A colonial and neo-classical home with tall white columns.
projects.alt: White colonial house with columns and balconies at dusk
projects.intro: This 13,639 sq ft home in Bangalore blends Colonial and Neo-Classical styles. Stately columns, a symmetrical facade and wide verandas set the character.
projects.story: High ceilings, moulding and a harmonious use of space follow neo-classical rules. Colonial grandeur gives the house its presence.
projects.detail: Interiors pair modern comforts with traditional craftsmanship, in a home meant to feel timeless.

projects.name: The Raghupathi Bhat Villa
projects.tagline: A 9,000 sq ft villa in Manipal inspired by the International style.
projects.detail_caption: The staircase over the dining hall.
projects.alt: Night view of a modern two-storey villa with glass walls and a lit lawn
projects.intro: The Raghupathi Bhat Villa in Manipal blends South Indian tradition with Brahmanic design principles. It follows the modernist ideas seen in Le Corbusier's Villa Savoye.
projects.story: Horizontal windows, a rooftop garden, pilotis, a free facade and an open floor plan define the design.
projects.detail: A sweeping timber staircase curves above the dining hall, and a night-lit pool runs along the upper floor.
